tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient observations reveal a strong decline absent from the pilot. Fit the guided siphon base and a gradient-triggered avalanche term jointly, then test the resulting law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation refuted it, and the new high-gradient measurements show a sharp decline.
The acquired observations span both sides of the proposed threshold and constrain the five-parameter stationary extension; confirmation is the next informative test.
The observed regime change is consistent with a stationary gradient threshold, with no reported chaotic sign-oscillation signature.
